name: audio-runtime-c11-hermetic-package-profile
_rejection_feedback: Reviewed PR #403 at head 1fc5663d against origin/main 668f2d88. Independent controls passed (31 cases), but actionable defects remain: profile.py:1496-1506 accepts manifests with monotonic_start_ns, monotonic_end_ns, and wall_seconds removed; analyze returned exit 0/status PASS with lane_wall_seconds null. profile.py:332-377 accepts quiet evidence whose before/after contain only active_work and no process/load observations; a matching-SHA probe also returned PASS. profile.py:844-874 only checks cache paths are absolute, so warm/run can direct GOCACHE and GOMODCACHE outside the manifest root, violating owned-cache isolation. profile.py:1307-1312 records no-test markers but profile.py:1496-1506 ignores them; the existing no-test stream returned PASS after its inventory package was marked as having tests. Malformed runs are also not schema-validated: replacing a run record with a string caused an uncaught AttributeError traceback at profile.py:1827-1834. Repair the same PR in scope, add public controls for these boundaries, regenerate exact-head evidence, push a new checkpoint, and resubmit to script-owned CI and independent review. Do not merge this head.

name: audio-runtime-c13-recorded-pcm-integrity
_rejection_feedback: Reviewed head 22bf02febbbd8f4ea92aeaa021d41c75f09e1978. Focused replay tests, race tests, and independent public untouched/mutated PCM probes passed. Found an integrity bypass at agent-cli/internal/services/internal/replay/recording_directory.go:19-24: os.Stat treats a dangling manifest.json symlink as absent, so session replay falls back to standalone trace replay and exits 0 with Replay verified. This violates the requirement that malformed/incomplete root manifests cannot fall back. Fix with Lstat and explicit symlink/non-regular rejection while preserving truly absent-manifest legacy trace compatibility; add a public regression for the dangling manifest, rerun focused normal/race and both public routes, push a new head, and return to script CI. No merge.

name: audio-runtime-c11-hermetic-package-profile

Independent controls passed 42 cases, but actionable defects remain: profile.py:2141-2287 can report PASS when an unreferenced invalid run group exists; a requested_repetitions=0 group produced exit 0/status PASS. profile.py:1490-1557 does not verify retained metadata command artifacts, so coordinated forged manifest/record/source-validation SHAs produced PASS despite unchanged captured git output. profile.py:1662-1690 and 2287 omit timingate-compatible aggregate time.Duration overflow checks; two 9e9-second package terminals produced PASS with a 36e9-second total. parse_record_stream also accepts records with argv, cwd, env_overrides, timeout, byte counts and schema removed, still returning PASS. Finally, assessment.json and evidence-ledger/pr-body identify bc7609b5 as the tested/current head while the PR is e982b3b9. No merge performed.

name: audio-runtime-c13-recorded-pcm-integrity
_rejection_feedback: PR #405 head 63e6b77b3f642bfd078d964a73eebfb235b1371c has all 9 required checks passing, but independent exact-binary probing found a public-path integrity bypass. In go-agent-runtime/services/replay/internal/plan/directory.go:92-96, loadRecordingManifest uses os.ReadFile and follows a root manifest symlink. A bundle with manifest.json symlinked to an external valid manifest caused `session --replay <bundle> --audio-out <file>` to exit 0 with replay_complete, while `session replay <bundle>` correctly rejected it via agent-cli/internal/services/internal/replay/recording_directory.go. This violates prd.json's shared root-boundary and unsafe-evidence requirements. Next action: reject root manifest symlinks/non-regular files in the runtime replay service before reading, preserve only truly absent-manifest legacy behavior, add a regression through the public --audio-out route, rerun focused normal/race/probe checks, push a new head, and return to the script CI gate. Do not merge the current head.
